style: More aggressive under Tuchel: high press, wingers isolating defenders one-v-one, Rice anchoring behind a No. 10 feeding a focal-point striker.
recent_form: Strong qualifying under Thomas Tuchel; arrived as a top-four ranked side and genuine contender after reaching Euro 2024 final.

key_players.name: Harry Kane
key_players.note: Prolific Bayern striker in elite form; focal point and leader.

key_players.name: Jude Bellingham
key_players.note: Drives play behind Kane; big-moment performer though facing competition for his spot.

key_players.name: Bukayo Saka
key_players.note: England's most reliable route into the final third with dribbling and end product.

key_players.name: Declan Rice
key_players.note: Screens the back four and recycles possession; the press depends on him.

key_players.name: Anthony Gordon
key_players.note: Direct runner suited to Tuchel's isolation-based wing play.

historical_news: 1966 World Cup winners; long drought without a major men's title since.
Euro 2020 and Euro 2024 runners-up under Gareth Southgate.
Thomas Tuchel era brings a more aggressive, attacking identity.
Squad snubs of Cole Palmer and Phil Foden generated debate.
Perennial 'football's coming home' expectation and knockout-stage scrutiny.

media_sentiment.label: positive
media_sentiment.summary: Treated as a strong contender with optimism around Tuchel's bolder approach, tempered by history of falling short.
